messages:
Maya Patel: FYI - BoltRetail escalated. Their March invoice is 1.9M tokens but their dashboard shows ~1.1M. Customer asking for refund / explanation. (Invoice #BR-20260301)
Tom Guerrero: assigning to billing ops + infra. @BillingOps @Liam Chen can you triage?
BillingOps: On it. Can you paste the invoice link and customer dashboard screenshot?
Maya Patel: invoice: https://pay.redwood.example/invoices/BR-20260301 (redacted) and screenshot uploaded to thread. Customer says spike happened at 00:30 UTC.
Liam Chen: quick summary from initial logs: ingestion sampler job in region eu-west-1 ran a retry that re-emitted a full-day sample batch to the billing pipeline. Looks like sampling TTL was missing so we double-counted a slice.
Nidhi Rao: is this the streaming sampler or the nightly aggregator?
Liam Chen: nightly aggregator + sampling hook. The sampler should emit representative keys, but a bug in the dedupe gate let through the full stream for partition shards 13..16.
Mark O'Neill: can you paste the relevant logs / query that shows duplication?
Liam Chen: here's the quick repro log snippet:
```
2026-03-01T00:29:58Z sampler-worker-7 INFO emit_batch partition=shard-14 sample_count=1 batch_size=158732
2026-03-01T00:29:58Z sampler-worker-7 WARN dedupe_gate: disabled (missing ttl) partition=shard-14
2026-03-01T00:29:59Z billing-proxy-3 INFO events_ingested count=158732 source=sampler-worker-7
2026-03-01T00:30:00Z billing-aggregator INFO write_ledger ledger_rows=158732 batch_id=20260301-00
```
Liam Chen: SQL to spot duplicates in ledger:
```
SELECT customer_id, event_hash, count(*) as c FROM billing.ledger
WHERE invoice_date='2026-03-01' AND customer_id='bolt_retail'
GROUP BY customer_id,event_hash HAVING c > 1 LIMIT 10;
```
BillingOps: confirmed duplicates for bolt_retail, ~820k duplicate tokens attributed to shard range.
Maya Patel: customer wants provisional credit immediately. What's our operational path?
BillingOps: recommend provisional credit for the duplicate amount (estimate 820k tokens). We'll create a temporary credit and flag for finance review.
FinanceBot: provisional_credit_created id=PC-20260301-BR amount_tokens=820000 status=pending_approval
Tom Guerrero: please capture root cause and a revrec note for the finance team. Revrec needs a short description and ledger refs.
Nidhi Rao: I'll draft revrec note. Suggest phrasing: "Provisional credit issued for duplicate ledger ingestion caused by missing TTL on sampler dedupe gate. Duplicate ledger rows: <ids>. Estimated tokens: 820,000. Adjustment pending final audit."
Mark O'Neill: Eng infra: what's the rollback / fix?
Liam Chen: hotfix pushed: add TTL default to dedupe gate + a guard to reject batch_size > 10k unless verified. Deployed to eu-west-1 at 01:05 UTC.
BillingOps: action items for postmortem / finance: 1) Final token recount, 2) Apply provisional credit to customer invoice or issue refund once audit done, 3) Generate revrec adjustment entry referencing PC-20260301-BR and ledger rows.
Maya Patel: Customer asked for ETA on credit posting. Can we commit to posting within 24 hours?
BillingOps: yes — provisional credit will appear as a line on invoice update within 24h. Final adjustment after audit may take up to 5 business days.
Tom Guerrero: Nidhi / FinanceBot, make sure accounting gets the revrec docs and the external-facing note. Also tag customer success for the comms.
Nidhi Rao: will prepare note and attach ledger id list + audit SQL output.
Liam Chen: added reproducible steps for internal runbook:
1) run duplicate query above for invoice date and customer
2) diff ledger vs sampler raw stream via event_hash
3) mark rows with duplicative_batch=true and capture batch_id
4) compute token delta = sum(dup.token_count)
5) create provisional credit with reason="duplicate ingestion"

Example CLI to generate delta:
```
python tooling/billing/reconcile.py --customer bolt_retail --date 2026-03-01 --mode sample
```
BillingOps: took provisional action: created PC-20260301-BR and notified finance. Customer success notified BoltRetail that we're investigating and issued provisional credit pending audit.
Maya Patel: Customer replied: appreciates speed, wants confirmation when final invoice is updated.
Mark O'Neill: follow-up - add telemetry alert to catch dedupe TTL regressions. I'll open an infra ticket.
Tom Guerrero: thanks team. Keep thread updated with final token delta and credit posting.
FinanceBot: audit_job_started id=AJ-20260301-BR status=running
BillingOps: final token recount currently estimating final delta = 812,400 tokens (slight reduction after filtering system events). Will update once audit_job completes.
Maya Patel: copied to customer success for comms. Closing loop when finance posts revrec. :white_check_mark:
